rows.Origin:
Bred by David L. Armstrong (United States, before 1970).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 1970 as 'Aquarius'.
Introduced in Australia by Roy H. Rumsey Pty. Ltd. in 1974 as 'Aquarius'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, cream shading, ages to lighter . Mild fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Large, leathery foliage.

Height: up to 3' (up to 90cm).
